author: Ziet Invests
body:

⬇️ Timestamps: 
0:00 → Introduction
1:34 → Webull Malaysia
2:51 → The Rise of an Empire
4:24 → Genting Group’s Expansion
6:28 → The Empire’s Downfall
8:46 → A Glimmer of Hope
11:04 → What’s the Truth Behind Privatization?
12:45 → The Truth Behind it All
13:23 → Scenario 1: Crossing 90%
14:14 → Scenario 2: Between 75% & 90%
15:35 → Scenario 3: Below 75%
16:19 → Conclusion


The Genting story began in 1969 when Tan Sri Lim Goh Tong secured Malaysia’s first and only casino license against all odds, launching a hilltop resort that would eventually attract 30 million visitors annually. For decades, Genting Berhad stood as an untouchable blue-chip giant, diversifying into plantations, energy, and global hospitality across Singapore, the US, and the UK. However, recent years have brought mounting debt, rising online competition, and a surprising exit from the KLCI top 30 index.

In this video, an analysis is provided on Genting Berhad’s aggressive attempt to privatize its Malaysian unit amidst a stagnant local market and a landmark casino license win in New York City. Viewers will learn about the strategic correlation between the RM5.5 billion NYC expansion and the push for privatization, which allows for restructuring without public scrutiny. This deep dive benefits the audience by clarifying how institutional funds like EPF are impacted and explaining the three potential scenarios for minority shareholders as Genting attempts to reinvent its legacy.

body: @MuhdAkmalyoyoman90 It does look enjoyable at first, and first visit can be fun. The problem started after the Fox deal collapsed when Disney bought Fox. author: @andrecc1996
body: I have only vague memory of my chilhood trip to Genting Highlands. I remember it was like such a magical place to step into; the caterpillar monorail, the beautiful indoor man-made river, the boat paddling. I remember Ripley's Believe It or Not exhibition. The whole family was having such a joyous fun there. Now as an adult, I only recently brought my kids to Genting Highlands in 2024. And I HATE what has become of it. The indoor theme park is so dark with eye blinding flashy cyberpunk neon lights, even my kids' eyes were hurting and they wanted to get out of there. Many rides are not children friendly as they have to pass certain height. The outdoor theme park feels fake and artificial, with only thrill rides, thrill rides and more thrill rides. Nothing feels magical and relaxing now. It doesn't feel like the place is catering to families with kids anymore. Hotel check in has also lost its human touch, as we have to check in with kiosks, and it's difficult to ask for help if we're having problems checking in. No longer do we feel the warm greeting from the front office staffs to welcome us to a magical place. Everything is just done by machine. It feels so dystopian.

I have only vague memory of my chilhood trip to Genting Highlands. I remember it was like such a magical place to step into; the caterpillar monorail, the beautiful indoor man-made river, the boat paddling. I remember Ripley's Believe It or Not exhibition. The whole family was having such a joyous fun there.

Now as an adult, I only recently brought my kids to Genting Highlands in 2024. And I HATE what has become of it. The indoor theme park is so dark with eye blinding flashy cyberpunk neon lights, even my kids' eyes were hurting and they wanted to get out of there. Many rides are not children friendly as they have to pass certain height.

The outdoor theme park feels fake and artificial, with only thrill rides, thrill rides and more thrill rides. Nothing feels magical and relaxing now. It doesn't feel like the place is catering to families with kids anymore.

Hotel check in has also lost its human touch, as we have to check in with kiosks, and it's difficult to ask for help if we're having problems checking in. No longer do we feel the warm greeting from the front office staffs to welcome us to a magical place. Everything is just done by machine. It feels so dystopian.

author: @shampain7746
body: Genting: Then vs Now Genting 20 years ago The outdoor theme park was built to last and genuinely made for fun. Real rocks, aluminium, steel—proper engineering. Traffic flow made sense, and machine downtime was rare. When something did break, you knew it was getting a proper repair. The indoor games were fantastically designed, from the entrance of Jack & the Beanstalk all the way to the arcade and even the soft-toy selection. Everything felt thought out. The bus station was a decent walk from First World Hotel, but that walk was part of the experience. A gentle uphill slope, cool breeze, slightly tiring but rewarding—a small adventure that helped manage human traffic naturally. The casino was well planned too. Each hotel had outlets that fit its crowd: VIP section above Maxim Hotel for T20s and Platinum card holders Budget slot machines and baccarat above First World Hotel for the general public Resort Hotel lived up to its name. It focused on F&B—Coffee Bean outside, fast food like Marrybrown, and buffet options offering Malay, Chinese, and Indian cuisine upstairs. Genting now The outdoor theme park is mostly plastic. It looks meh and somehow feels even worse than it looks. Traffic flow is terrible—dead ends, weird U-turns, and paths that lead to unfinished areas. Mahal pulak tu. Last time, RM200 got you a one-year pass for all rides (except paid games). Now RM200 is per entry. Sial. Indoor games? Forget it. Might as well remove the entire indoor park—it’s a complete disaster. The bus stop is now underground beneath First World Hotel. Terrible decision. No more cool Genting breeze, no pleasant walk—just everyone suffocating in diesel fumes. Then everyone gets bottlenecked at the escalators to the lobby, which leads straight to the outdoor theme park. This one really damn bodoh. The casino still has good interior design—very Genting Group—but the operations are messy. During peak hours, tables are severely packed while other tables sit empty. During off-peak, it’s the opposite: overstaffed, with employees just standing around waiting. Okay lah, crowds are hard to predict—agak-agak only. But now you want to charge toll to the very gamblers who gave you all our money? Niama.

Genting: Then vs Now

Genting 20 years ago
The outdoor theme park was built to last and genuinely made for fun. Real rocks, aluminium, steel—proper engineering. Traffic flow made sense, and machine downtime was rare. When something did break, you knew it was getting a proper repair.

The indoor games were fantastically designed, from the entrance of Jack & the Beanstalk all the way to the arcade and even the soft-toy selection. Everything felt thought out.

The bus station was a decent walk from First World Hotel, but that walk was part of the experience. A gentle uphill slope, cool breeze, slightly tiring but rewarding—a small adventure that helped manage human traffic naturally.

The casino was well planned too. Each hotel had outlets that fit its crowd:

VIP section above Maxim Hotel for T20s and Platinum card holders

Budget slot machines and baccarat above First World Hotel for the general public

Resort Hotel lived up to its name. It focused on F&B—Coffee Bean outside, fast food like Marrybrown, and buffet options offering Malay, Chinese, and Indian cuisine upstairs.

Genting now
The outdoor theme park is mostly plastic. It looks meh and somehow feels even worse than it looks. Traffic flow is terrible—dead ends, weird U-turns, and paths that lead to unfinished areas. Mahal pulak tu. Last time, RM200 got you a one-year pass for all rides (except paid games). Now RM200 is per entry. Sial.

Indoor games? Forget it. Might as well remove the entire indoor park—it’s a complete disaster.

The bus stop is now underground beneath First World Hotel. Terrible decision. No more cool Genting breeze, no pleasant walk—just everyone suffocating in diesel fumes. Then everyone gets bottlenecked at the escalators to the lobby, which leads straight to the outdoor theme park. This one really damn bodoh.

The casino still has good interior design—very Genting Group—but the operations are messy. During peak hours, tables are severely packed while other tables sit empty. During off-peak, it’s the opposite: overstaffed, with employees just standing around waiting. Okay lah, crowds are hard to predict—agak-agak only.

But now you want to charge toll to the very gamblers who gave you all our money?

Niama.

title: Saham Genting Malaysia Jatuh, Rahasia Besar Indonesia Terbongkar!
author: PERSENAN
body:
Dunia bisnis Asia Tenggara sedang diguncang. Genting Berhad, raksasa kasino Malaysia yang selama puluhan tahun dianggap tak tergoyahkan, kini berada di titik terlemah dalam sejarahnya. Harga saham anjlok ke level terendah dua dekade, investor global panik, dan triliunan rupiah menguap.
Namun ini bukan sekadar cerita tentang kasino atau saham yang jatuh. Ini adalah kisah tentang Indonesia.
Tanpa disadari, uang rakyat Indonesia selama bertahun-tahun telah menjadi sumber utama kekuatan Genting Berhad. Dari meja judi di luar negeri, uang itu berubah menjadi modal raksasa, lalu kembali ke Indonesia dalam bentuk pembangkit listrik, pusat perbelanjaan, perkebunan sawit, hingga proyek gas strategis di Papua.
Sebagian listrik yang menyala di rumah kita, sebagian pusat belanja yang kita kunjungi, bahkan masa depan energi nasional, memiliki benang merah yang sama: Genting Berhad.
Video ini membongkar bagaimana larangan perjudian, kebocoran devisa, dan kebijakan ekonomi kawasan justru menciptakan paradoks besar. Indonesia menyumbang, membayar, tetapi tidak memiliki kendali. Sementara negara tetangga menikmati hasilnya.
Apakah status quo ini akan terus dibiarkan? Apakah sudah saatnya Indonesia berpikir ulang tentang strategi ekonomi, kedaulatan energi, dan aliran uang rakyat ke luar negeri?
Tonton sampai akhir untuk memahami bagaimana satu perusahaan kasino bisa menjadi cermin kompleksitas ekonomi Asia Tenggara, dan mengapa isu ini jauh lebih dekat dengan hidup kita daripada yang selama ini kita bayangkan.

title: Genting Malaysia (4715) Q2 2026: RM3.85B Revenue 📈, 89% Profit Drop! (NY Casino, Privatization)
author: Nighteyes08
body:
In this episode of Deep Dive, we analyze Genting Malaysia’s (GENM 4715) Q2 2026 financial performance. We unpack a major balance sheet paradox: record-breaking RM3.85 billion revenue driven by Resorts World New York City's live table games, contrasted against an 89% plunge in core net profit.

We examine the "cost of growth," heavy depreciation burdens, high interest on a massive RM15.7 billion debt pile, and forex losses. We also evaluate GENM’s updated Financial Moat Score (8.5/10), intrinsic valuation (RM1.98 vs RM1.72 market price), dividend sustainability, and the growing probability of a second privatization attempt by parent company Genting Berhad.

title: Genting跌回近25年低位，市场到底在怕什么？
author: AF's Notes
body:
Genting跌到历史低位，Genting Malaysia也跌破当年RM2.35的收购价，但两家公司第二季度revenue明明都在增长。
赌场生意真的变差了，还是市场其实在担心另一件更大的事？

2026年第二季度，Genting revenue增长14%，Genting Malaysia revenue更增长32%。可是到了股东盈利这一层，画面完全不一样：Genting从去年同期盈利变成亏损，Genting Malaysia的profit同比大跌89%。

所以这支影片，我不想只用“赌场没人去了”或者“RM5道路费影响生意”来解释股价。

我们会从 Genting 和 Genting Malaysia 的资产结构开始，拆开 Resorts World Genting、Resorts World New York City、Genting Singapore、Resorts World Las Vegas、Genting Plantations 和能源业务，再看看纽约赌场正式开业之后，到底给集团带来了什么。

重点会放在几个真正影响股东回报的数字：adjusted EBITDA、CFO、finance cost、借款、净负债、capex，以及纽约未来几年的资本承诺。

影片也会回头讨论2025年 Genting 以每股 RM2.35 收购 Genting Malaysia 的事件。为什么大股东过去愿意支付 RM2.35，不代表今天市场低过这个价格，就自动等于便宜？控制权、小股东 EPS 和 cash flow，本来就是不同的游戏。

最后我也会用 EV/EBITDA 来重新看 Genting 和 Genting Malaysia 的估值。对这种重资产、债务和折旧都很大的公司，只看 PE 很容易漏掉融资结构。

这支影片不讨论短期股价预测，也不是买卖建议。重点是看懂：当一家公司进入大规模扩张期，新增 EBITDA 和 CFO 能不能追得上 finance cost、capex 和债务增长。

title: The Genting Situation - current and its forecast into 27/28 payout
author: InvestDummies
body: Detail the financial trajectory and strategic expansion of Genting Berhad, a global conglomerate primarily focused on the leisure and hospitality sectors. Recent reports highlight a mix of revenue fluctuations and credit rating downgrades from Fitch, driven by high capital expenditures for major projects in Singapore and New York. Despite these short-term pressures, the group successfully transitioned to a commercial casino license at its New York City property, which is projected to see significant earnings growth by 2028. Beyond gaming, the sources outline performance across the company’s diversified portfolio, including its power generation, oil and gas, and plantation divisions. Management remains focused on operational efficiency and asset upgrades to navigate geopolitical tensions and evolving market demands. The records also track steady progress on large-scale transformations at Resorts World Sentosa and the recovery of VIP play at the Las Vegas resort.

title: 云顶股价跌回1998年水平，股东为什么还要再掏钱？
author: AF's Notes
body:
#genting #马股 #附加股  
云顶 Genting 集团截至六月底有 17.6 billion 现金，10 月 9 号却宣布 1.25 billion 的 rights issue（附加股），下一个交易日股价一天跌了 23%。
钱明明在账上，为什么不自己拿出来？这笔钱要拿去做什么，你手上的认购权又要怎么处理？

这次 Genting Berhad（3182）的附加股，不只是股东要不要再掏钱的问题。今年 9 月，Fitch 把云顶的评级从 BBB 降到 BBB-，S&P 也警告云顶有风险变成"堕落天使"。现在三家国际评级机构给云顶的评级，都只比垃圾级别高一级。云顶股价大跌那天，云顶大马（Genting Malaysia）也跌了大约 17%。附加股的价钱和比例还没定，现在正好先把逻辑看清楚。

✅ 本期必看点
- 17.6 billion 现金旁边，还有 45.3 billion 贷款，一年内到期的就有 9.7 billion
- Moody's，S&P 和 Fitch 这一年怎么看云顶，离垃圾级别还有多远
- 1.25 billion 拿去做什么？一年省 41.3 million 利息，算多还是少
- 按 10 月 14 号的股价，为什么整间云顶的市值，差不多只等于它手上那份云顶大马
- 附加股落实后的三条路，哪一条可能让你白白损失一笔钱

title: Genting’s $306M Cash Call: Why the Stock Crashed 17% in One Day
author: One Minute Finance
body:
Shares in Malaysian gaming and hospitality conglomerate Genting Berhad suffered their steepest single-day market collapse since the 1998 Asian financial crisis, plunging as much as 17% after the company unveiled an unexpected RM1.25 billion ($306 million) renounceable rights issue. For a blue-chip titan long favored by income investors, the sudden cash call sent shockwaves across regional equity markets.

In this corporate finance breakdown, we dissect the urgent debt pressures behind Genting’s $306M rights issue. We examine how massive capital expenditure for Resorts World New York City pushed group borrowings past RM45 billion ($11 billion), analyze the credit rating downgrades and "fallen angel" warnings that forced management into emergency deleveraging, and evaluate analyst warnings that this dilutive capital raise may only offer temporary relief against looming debt maturities.

💡 WHAT YOU'LL LEARN:
• The deal structure behind Genting’s $306 million rights issue and the Lim family's subscription commitments
• How massive expansion spending in New York inflated group borrowings to over RM45 billion
• Why credit rating downgrades from Fitch and S&P pressured management into emergency equity fundraising
• The anatomy of the market reaction: Unpacking the historic 17% stock crash and deep dilution discounts
• The road ahead: Why leading investment banks warn that further equity raises or dividend cuts could follow

Public corporate rights issues, casino equities, and emerging market stocks carry significant volatility, dilution, and credit risks. title: Genting Berhad暴跌23%！现在可以上车吗？#Genting #GentingBerhad #马股 #马来西亚股票 #股票投资 #Genting暴跌 #股票大跌 #3182  #双阳倍量
author: 双阳倍量 Double Volume Bullish Channel
body:
# Genting Berhad急跌后可以上车吗？

Genting Berhad突然大跌，很多散户第一反应是：股价已经跌了这么多，是不是便宜了？现在买入，等反弹就能赚钱？但在股票市场，跌幅大不代表风险低，更不代表股价已经见底。

**第一，先看股价为什么下跌。** 2026年10月12日，Genting Berhad因宣布计划通过供股筹集RM12.5亿令吉，股价一度跌至RM1.56，盘中跌幅约17%。公司计划用部分资金偿还短期借款，其余主要用于营运资金。市场担心融资需求、每股盈利摊薄及未来股息，因此出现明显卖压。

**第二，不要把急跌当成抄底信号。** 当股价出现跳空下跌，如果卖压持续、成交量放大，而且股价无法收复关键位置，说明市场仍可能在重新评估公司的风险。此时急着买入，可能遇到第二波下跌。

**第三，观察成交量与支撑位。** 如果股价下跌后，卖压逐渐减弱，开始出现较稳定的横盘，并且能够重新站回短期关键价位，才值得进一步观察。但单日反弹并不能证明趋势已经反转，也要防范反弹后再次破底。

**第四，研究供股对股东的实际影响。** 投资者需要了解供股比例、认购价格、除权安排、公司债务变化，以及未来盈利和现金流能否改善。供股可能帮助公司降低债务压力，但也可能增加股份数量，影响每股指标。不能只因为股价跌了，就认定估值已经便宜。

**第五，制定进场和退出计划。** 不要一次投入全部资金，也不要因为害怕错过反弹而追价。先决定可承受的亏损，再考虑分批布局；如果基本面持续恶化或价格走势不符合预期，就要重新评估。

对于Genting Berhad，真正重要的问题不是“已经跌了多少”，而是“卖压是否减弱、融资风险是否清晰，以及公司未来能否改善现金流”。**先观察，再判断；先管理风险，再考虑回报。** 这才是散户面对急跌股时应该建立的投资纪律。

量价关系与“双阳倍量”

量价关系是股票技术分析的重要基础。价格走势反映市场方向，而成交量则反映市场参与度与资金活跃度。

量价齐升通常显示市场买盘增强；价涨量缩可能代表上涨动力减弱；放量下跌则需要警惕市场抛售压力。

**“双阳倍量”**是一种量价形态：连续两根阳线，第二天收盘价高于第一天，同时成交量显著放大，通常以第二天成交量达到第一天的 2倍或以上作为筛选条件之一。

本课程将结合 KLCI、马股、美股及实际案例，讲解如何运用量价关系与“双阳倍量”寻找趋势、观察资金活跃度，并建立更有纪律的交易分析方法。

注意：技术指标仅作为分析工具，并不能保证股票上涨或投资获利。

English
Volume-Price Analysis & “Double Bullish Volume”

The relationship between price and trading volume is a key foundation of technical analysis. Price reflects market direction, while volume indicates market participation and trading activity.

Rising price with rising volume may indicate stronger buying interest. Rising price with declining volume may suggest weakening momentum, while falling price with increasing volume may signal stronger selling pressure.

“Double Bullish Volume” is a volume-price pattern involving two consecutive bullish candles, with the second day's closing price higher than the first and trading volume significantly increased—commonly screened using 2 times or more of the previous day's volume as one condition.

This course uses practical examples from KLCI, Bursa Malaysia, NYSE and NASDAQ to explore volume-price analysis, the Double Bullish Volume pattern, trend identification and di

title: Genting Malaysia (GENM) Q3 2025: Revenue +22%, Profit –79% (Forex Shock & RM2.35 Takeover Battle)
author: Nighteyes08
body:
The Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM) Q3 2025 results highlight a sharp paradox: strong operations but highly unstable reported earnings.

Revenue surged 22% to ~RM3.4B, driven by higher gaming volumes at RWG and full consolidation of US assets. Yet Net Profit collapsed 79% to RM119.7M due to extreme forex volatility—net unrealised FX gains fell from RM601.8M to just RM2.8M. Excluding this accounting noise, Adjusted EBITDA rose 19%, underscoring solid core performance.

At the same time, GENM faces a contentious RM2.35 takeover offer from Genting Berhad (GENT). The independent adviser deemed the offer “not fair,” valuing GENM much higher at RM3.48–RM3.77. Minority shareholders remain firm, especially ahead of the pivotal USD5.5B RWNYC commercial casino license decision—widely seen as the key catalyst that could unlock GENM’s intrinsic value.

title: 云顶要跟股东拿 12.5 亿，为什么？｜你的 1,000 股会怎样?
author: 棋有此理
body:
云顶为什么要跟股东拿 12.5 亿？

一年做 288 亿的生意，还要跟你拿钱。消息一出，股价一天跌 23%，跌到二十年来最低。我把数字一个一个看：赚的钱去哪了、176 亿 cash 为什么还不够、12.5 亿到底拿去做什么，还有你的 1,000 股，出钱、卖认购权、不理，各会怎样。

我是棋有此理，本行工业工程师。我看公司，就像看一条生产线：跟着钱走，找它卡在哪里。
